subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: Should Control UI/WebChat provide built-in inline remote media and rich web previews, and what trust policy should govern browser or gateway fetches?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally prevent arbitrary remote browser image/media fetches, while the requested feature would add new user-facing preview behavior and security-sensitive fetch surfaces.

options.title: Define secure media policy first
options.body: Recommended: keep the current safe defaults while maintainers specify allowed sources, proxying, consent, caching, CSP, and proof expectations before implementation slices proceed.

options.title: Delegate to focused items
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella and resolve remaining behavior through focused items such as remote Markdown images, audio autoplay, and GitHub/web previews.

options.title: Allow direct remote previews
options.body: Accept the privacy and tracking tradeoff and update the renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together for direct remote media loads.

recommendation.title: Define secure media policy first
recommendation.body: Recommended: keep the current safe defaults while maintainers specify allowed sources, proxying, consent, caching, CSP, and proof expectations before implementation slices proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy, where drobison00 has the strongest direct merged-history signal.
